def _chatter_pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue
parts = source.split('%s') if not text.startswith(parts[0]): continue
pos = len(parts[0]) values = [] ok = True
for index in range(1, len(parts)): part = parts[index]
if part: next_pos = text.find(part, pos) if next_pos < 0: ok = False break values.append(text[pos:next_pos]) pos = next_pos + len(part) else: if index == len(parts) - 1: values.append(text[pos:]) pos = len(text) else: ok = False break
if ok and pos == len(text): try: if len(values) == 1: return target % values[0] return target % tuple(values) except Exception: return target
return None
def chatter_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, CHATTER_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text

def _pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue prefix, suffix = source.split('%s', 1) if text.startswith(prefix) and text.endswith(suffix): value = text[len(prefix):len(text) - len(suffix)] if suffix else text[len(prefix):] try: return target % value except Exception: return target
return None
def ui_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _pattern_translate(text, UI_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text

def _chatter_pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue
parts = source.split('%s') if not text.startswith(parts[0]): continue
pos = len(parts[0]) values = [] ok = True
for index in range(1, len(parts)): part = parts[index]
if part: next_pos = text.find(part, pos) if next_pos < 0: ok = False break values.append(text[pos:next_pos]) pos = next_pos + len(part) else: if index == len(parts) - 1: values.append(text[pos:]) pos = len(text) else: ok = False break
if ok and pos == len(text): try: if len(values) == 1: return target % values[0] return target % tuple(values) except Exception: return target
return None
def chatter_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, CHATTER_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text

def _pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue prefix, suffix = source.split('%s', 1) if text.startswith(prefix) and text.endswith(suffix): value = text[len(prefix):len(text) - len(suffix)] if suffix else text[len(prefix):] try: return target % value except Exception: return target
return None
def ui_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _pattern_translate(text, UI_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text

created_now = False

def _chatter_pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue
parts = source.split('%s') if not text.startswith(parts[0]): continue
pos = len(parts[0]) values = [] ok = True
for index in range(1, len(parts)): part = parts[index]
if part: next_pos = text.find(part, pos) if next_pos < 0: ok = False break values.append(text[pos:next_pos]) pos = next_pos + len(part) else: if index == len(parts) - 1: values.append(text[pos:]) pos = len(text) else: ok = False break
if ok and pos == len(text): try: if len(values) == 1: return target % values[0] return target % tuple(values) except Exception: return target
return None
def chatter_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, CHATTER_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text

def _pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue prefix, suffix = source.split('%s', 1) if text.startswith(prefix) and text.endswith(suffix): value = text[len(prefix):len(text) - len(suffix)] if suffix else text[len(prefix):] try: return target % value except Exception: return target
return None
def ui_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _pattern_translate(text, UI_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text

created_now = False
if not declaration: sequence = declaration_model.search_count([ ('x_applicant_id', '=', applicant.id), ('x_declaration_type', '=', 'non_disclosure_agreement'), ]) + 1
applicant_name = applicant.partner_name or applicant.name or applicant.display_name

action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.act_window', 'name': declaration.x_name or 'إقرار السرية وعدم الإفصاح F-0009', 'res_model': 'x_hr.applicant_declaration', 'res_id': declaration.id, 'view_mode': 'form', 'target': 'current', }

break

for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue
parts = source.split('%s') if not text.startswith(parts[0]): continue
pos = len(parts[0]) values = [] ok = True
for index in range(1, len(parts)): part = parts[index]
if part: next_pos = text.find(part, pos) if next_pos < 0: ok = False break values.append(text[pos:next_pos]) pos = next_pos + len(part) else: if index == len(parts) - 1: values.append(text[pos:]) pos = len(text) else: ok = False break
if ok and pos == len(text): try: if len(values) == 1: return target % values[0] return target % tuple(values) except Exception: return target
return None
def chatter_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, CHATTER_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text

def _chatter_pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue
parts = source.split('%s') if not text.startswith(parts[0]): continue
pos = len(parts[0]) values = [] ok = True
for index in range(1, len(parts)): part = parts[index]
if part: next_pos = text.find(part, pos) if next_pos < 0: ok = False break values.append(text[pos:next_pos]) pos = next_pos + len(part) else: if index == len(parts) - 1: values.append(text[pos:]) pos = len(text) else: ok = False break
if ok and pos == len(text): try: if len(values) == 1: return target % values[0] return target % tuple(values) except Exception: return target
return None

for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue prefix, suffix = source.split('%s', 1) if text.startswith(prefix) and text.endswith(suffix): value = text[len(prefix):len(text) - len(suffix)] if suffix else text[len(prefix):] try: return target % value except Exception: return target
return None

translated = _pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text

def _chatter_pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue
parts = source.split('%s') if not text.startswith(parts[0]): continue
pos = len(parts[0]) values = [] ok = True
for index in range(1, len(parts)): part = parts[index]
if part: next_pos = text.find(part, pos) if next_pos < 0: ok = False break values.append(text[pos:next_pos]) pos = next_pos + len(part) else: if index == len(parts) - 1: values.append(text[pos:]) pos = len(text) else: ok = False break
if ok and pos == len(text): try: if len(values) == 1: return target % values[0] return target % tuple(values) except Exception: return target
return None
def chatter_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, CHATTER_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text

def _pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue prefix, suffix = source.split('%s', 1) if text.startswith(prefix) and text.endswith(suffix): value = text[len(prefix):len(text) - len(suffix)] if suffix else text[len(prefix):] try: return target % value except Exception: return target
return None
def ui_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _pattern_translate(text, UI_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text

def _chatter_pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue
parts = source.split('%s') if not text.startswith(parts[0]): continue
pos = len(parts[0]) values = [] ok = True
for index in range(1, len(parts)): part = parts[index]
if part: next_pos = text.find(part, pos) if next_pos < 0: ok = False break values.append(text[pos:next_pos]) pos = next_pos + len(part) else: if index == len(parts) - 1: values.append(text[pos:]) pos = len(text) else: ok = False break
if ok and pos == len(text): try: if len(values) == 1: return target % values[0] return target % tuple(values) except Exception: return target
return None
def chatter_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, CHATTER_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text

def _pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue prefix, suffix = source.split('%s', 1) if text.startswith(prefix) and text.endswith(suffix): value = text[len(prefix):len(text) - len(suffix)] if suffix else text[len(prefix):] try: return target % value except Exception: return target
return None
def ui_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _pattern_translate(text, UI_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text
setup_error = False
if not signature_type: setup_error = 'Odoo Sign signature field type could not be found: sign.sign_item_type_signature.' elif not applicant_role: setup_error = 'No Odoo Sign signer role was found. Create an Applicant, Employee, Customer, or Signatory role before sending F-0007.'
def toast(title, message, kind='warning', sticky=False): return { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': ui_text(title), 'message': ui_text(message), 'type': kind, 'sticky': sticky, }, }

if rec.x_state != 'generated' or not rec.x_pdf_attachment_id: action = toast('F-0007 غير جاهز للإرسال', 'أنشئ ملف F-0007 PDF قبل إرساله عبر توقيع أودو.', 'warning', False) continue
applicant = rec.x_applicant_id if not applicant: action = toast('لا يوجد متقدم', 'لا يمكن إرسال F-0007 بدون متقدم مرتبط.', 'warning', True) continue
applicant_name = applicant.partner_name or applicant.name or applicant.display_name applicant_email = applicant.email_from or False
applicant_partner = False if 'partner_id' in applicant._fields and applicant.partner_id: applicant_partner = applicant.partner_id.sudo()
if not applicant_partner and applicant_email: applicant_partner = partner_model.search([('email', '=', applicant_email)], order='id asc', limit=1)
if not applicant_partner and applicant_email: applicant_partner = partner_model.create({ 'name': applicant_name or applicant_email, 'email': applicant_email, })
if not applicant_partner or not (applicant_partner.email or applicant_email): action = toast('بريد المتقدم غير موجود', 'أضف بريداً إلكترونياً للمتقدم قبل إرسال F-0007 عبر توقيع أودو.', 'warning', True) continue
pdf_attachment = rec.x_pdf_attachment_id filename = pdf_attachment.name or ('%s - F-0007 إقرار الالتزام باللوائح والسياسات.pdf' % applicant_name)

def _chatter_pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue
parts = source.split('%s') if not text.startswith(parts[0]): continue
pos = len(parts[0]) values = [] ok = True
for index in range(1, len(parts)): part = parts[index]
if part: next_pos = text.find(part, pos) if next_pos < 0: ok = False break values.append(text[pos:next_pos]) pos = next_pos + len(part) else: if index == len(parts) - 1: values.append(text[pos:]) pos = len(text) else: ok = False break
if ok and pos == len(text): try: if len(values) == 1: return target % values[0] return target % tuple(values) except Exception: return target
return None
def chatter_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, CHATTER_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text

def _pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue prefix, suffix = source.split('%s', 1) if text.startswith(prefix) and text.endswith(suffix): value = text[len(prefix):len(text) - len(suffix)] if suffix else text[len(prefix):] try: return target % value except Exception: return target
return None

try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _pattern_translate(text, UI_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text

return text

def _chatter_pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue
parts = source.split('%s') if not text.startswith(parts[0]): continue
pos = len(parts[0]) values = [] ok = True
for index in range(1, len(parts)): part = parts[index]
if part: next_pos = text.find(part, pos) if next_pos < 0: ok = False break values.append(text[pos:next_pos]) pos = next_pos + len(part) else: if index == len(parts) - 1: values.append(text[pos:]) pos = len(text) else: ok = False break
if ok and pos == len(text): try: if len(values) == 1: return target % values[0] return target % tuple(values) except Exception: return target
return None
def chatter_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, CHATTER_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text

def _pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue prefix, suffix = source.split('%s', 1) if text.startswith(prefix) and text.endswith(suffix): value = text[len(prefix):len(text) - len(suffix)] if suffix else text[len(prefix):] try: return target % value except Exception: return target
return None
def ui_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _pattern_translate(text, UI_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text
def toast(title, message, kind='warning', sticky=False, reload=False): params = { 'title': ui_text(title), 'message': ui_text(message), 'type': kind, 'sticky': sticky, } if reload: params['next'] = {'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'reload'} return { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': params, }

def _chatter_pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue
parts = source.split('%s') if not text.startswith(parts[0]): continue
pos = len(parts[0]) values = [] ok = True
for index in range(1, len(parts)): part = parts[index]
if part: next_pos = text.find(part, pos) if next_pos < 0: ok = False break values.append(text[pos:next_pos]) pos = next_pos + len(part) else: if index == len(parts) - 1: values.append(text[pos:]) pos = len(text) else: ok = False break
if ok and pos == len(text): try: if len(values) == 1: return target % values[0] return target % tuple(values) except Exception: return target
return None
def chatter_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, CHATTER_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text

def _pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue prefix, suffix = source.split('%s', 1) if text.startswith(prefix) and text.endswith(suffix): value = text[len(prefix):len(text) - len(suffix)] if suffix else text[len(prefix):] try: return target % value except Exception: return target
return None
def ui_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _pattern_translate(text, UI_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text
def toast(title, message, kind='warning', sticky=False, reload=False): params = { 'title': ui_text(title), 'message': ui_text(message), 'type': kind, 'sticky': sticky, } if reload: params['next'] = {'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'reload'} return { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': params, }

def _chatter_pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue
parts = source.split('%s') if not text.startswith(parts[0]): continue
pos = len(parts[0]) values = [] ok = True
for index in range(1, len(parts)): part = parts[index]
if part: next_pos = text.find(part, pos) if next_pos < 0: ok = False break values.append(text[pos:next_pos]) pos = next_pos + len(part) else: if index == len(parts) - 1: values.append(text[pos:]) pos = len(text) else: ok = False break
if ok and pos == len(text): try: if len(values) == 1: return target % values[0] return target % tuple(values) except Exception: return target
return None
def chatter_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, CHATTER_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _chatter_pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text

def _pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue prefix, suffix = source.split('%s', 1) if text.startswith(prefix) and text.endswith(suffix): value = text[len(prefix):len(text) - len(suffix)] if suffix else text[len(prefix):] try: return target % value except Exception: return target
return None
def ui_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _pattern_translate(text, UI_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text
for rec in records.sudo(): applicant = rec.x_applicant_id
if not applicant: action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': ui_text('لا يوجد متقدم'), 'message': ui_text('لا يمكن مزامنة F-0004 بدون متقدم مرتبط.'), 'type': 'warning', 'sticky': True, } } continue
registry_doc = registry_model.search([ ('x_document_type', '=', 'legal_documents_validity_declaration'), ('x_source_model', '=', 'x_hr.applicant_declaration'), ('x_source_res_id', '=', rec.id), ('x_signature_mode', '=', 'native_sign'), ('x_sign_request_res_id', '!=', False), ], order='id desc', limit=1)
if not registry_doc: registry_doc = registry_model.search([ ('x_document_type', '=', 'legal_documents_validity_declaration'), ('x_applicant_id', '=', applicant.id), ('x_signature_mode', '=', 'native_sign'), ('x_sign_request_res_id', '!=', False), ], order='id desc', limit=1)
if not registry_doc: action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': ui_text('لا يوجد طلب توقيع مرتبط'), 'message': ui_text('لم يتم العثور على سجل F-0004 مرتبط بطلب توقيع أودو.'), 'type': 'warning', 'sticky': True, } } continue
sign_request = sign_request_model.browse(registry_doc.x_sign_request_res_id) if not sign_request.exists(): action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': ui_text('طلب التوقيع غير موجود'), 'message': ui_text('طلب توقيع أودو المرتبط لم يعد موجوداً أو لا يمكن الوصول إليه.'), 'type': 'warning', 'sticky': True, } } continue
request_state = sign_request.state or 'unknown'
registry_doc.write({ 'x_sign_request_state': request_state, 'x_sign_request_reference': sign_request.reference or registry_doc.x_sign_request_reference, })
if request_state not in ['signed', 'completed']: rec.message_post(body=chatter_text('F-0004 Sign request is not complete yet. Current request state: %s.' % request_state)) applicant.message_post(body=chatter_text('F-0004 signature state checked. Current state: %s.' % request_state))
action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': ui_text('F-0004 لم يكتمل توقيعه'), 'message': ui_text('طلب توقيع أودو لا يزال بحالة: %s.') % request_state, 'type': 'warning', 'sticky': False, } } continue
completed_attachments = sign_request.completed_document_attachment_ids
# Robust attachment discovery: # Odoo Sign may expose the certificate and signed PDF differently depending on the # request/context. Never treat the certificate as the signed business document. related_attachments = env['ir.attachment'].sudo().search([ ('res_model', '=', 'sign.request'), ('res_id', '=', sign_request.id), ('mimetype', '=', 'application/pdf'), ], order='create_date desc, id desc')
all_completed_attachments = completed_attachments | related_attachments
if not all_completed_attachments: registry_doc.write({ 'x_sign_request_state': 'signed_no_completed_attachment_found', 'x_notes': ((registry_doc.x_notes or '') + '\\nOdoo Sign request %s is signed, but no completed document attachments were found during F-0004 sync on %s.' % (sign_request.id, datetime.datetime.now())).strip(), })
action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': ui_text('المستند الموقع غير موجود'), 'message': ui_text('طلب التوقيع موقّع، لكن لم يتم العثور على مرفقات المستند المكتمل.'), 'type': 'warning', 'sticky': True, } } continue
signed_native = False certificate_native = False
for attachment in all_completed_attachments: attachment_name = (attachment.name or '').lower() is_certificate = ( 'certificate' in attachment_name or 'completion' in attachment_name or 'history' in attachment_name or 'audit' in attachment_name or 'شهادة' in attachment_name )
if is_certificate: if not certificate_native: certificate_native = attachment elif not signed_native: signed_native = attachment
if not signed_native: registry_doc.write({ 'x_sign_request_state': 'signed_no_business_document_found', 'x_notes': ((registry_doc.x_notes or '') + '\\nOdoo Sign request %s is signed, but only certificate/history attachments were found during F-0004 sync on %s.' % (sign_request.id, datetime.datetime.now())).strip(), })
action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': ui_text('المستند الموقع غير موجود'), 'message': ui_text('تم العثور على شهادة التوقيع فقط، ولم يتم العثور على نسخة F-0004 الموقعة. افتح طلب التوقيع الأصلي وتحقق من المرفقات قبل إعادة المزامنة.'), 'type': 'warning', 'sticky': True, } } continue
signed_copy = registry_doc.x_signed_attachment_id
# Do not trust a previously linked signed attachment blindly. # Earlier F-0004 test syncs could place the certificate in the signed-document field. # If the current signed attachment looks like a certificate/history file, move it into # the certificate path and replace the signed document from the actual signed business PDF. if signed_copy: signed_copy_name = (signed_copy.name or '').lower() signed_copy_is_certificate = ( 'certificate' in signed_copy_name or 'completion' in signed_copy_name or 'history' in signed_copy_name or 'audit' in signed_copy_name or 'شهادة' in signed_copy_name )
if signed_copy_is_certificate: if not certificate_native: certificate_native = signed_copy signed_copy = False
certificate_copy = registry_doc.x_sign_certificate_attachment_id
if not certificate_copy and certificate_native: certificate_copy_name = certificate_native.name or ('Certificate of completion - F-0004 - %s.pdf' % (applicant.partner_name or applicant.name or applicant.display_name))
if certificate_native.res_model == 'hr.applicant' and certificate_native.res_id == applicant.id: certificate_copy = certificate_native else: certificate_copy = certificate_native.copy({ 'name': certificate_copy_name, 'res_model': 'hr.applicant', 'res_id': applicant.id, })
if not signed_copy: signed_copy = signed_native.copy({ 'name': signed_native.name or ('Signed F-0004 - %s.pdf' % (applicant.partner_name or applicant.name or applicant.display_name)), 'res_model': 'hr.applicant', 'res_id': applicant.id, })
signed_on = False signer_items = sign_request.request_item_ids.filtered(lambda item: item.state == 'completed') for signer_item in signer_items: if signer_item.write_date and (not signed_on or signer_item.write_date > signed_on): signed_on = signer_item.write_date
if not signed_on and sign_request.write_date: signed_on = sign_request.write_date

def _pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue prefix, suffix = source.split('%s', 1) if text.startswith(prefix) and text.endswith(suffix): value = text[len(prefix):len(text) - len(suffix)] if suffix else text[len(prefix):] try: return target % value except Exception: return target
return None
def ui_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _pattern_translate(text, UI_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text

def _pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue prefix, suffix = source.split('%s', 1) if text.startswith(prefix) and text.endswith(suffix): value = text[len(prefix):len(text) - len(suffix)] if suffix else text[len(prefix):] try: return target % value except Exception: return target
return None
def ui_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _pattern_translate(text, UI_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text
def toast(title, message, kind='warning', sticky=False): return { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': ui_text(title), 'message': ui_text(message), 'type': kind, 'sticky': sticky, }, }
def document_type_for(declaration): mapping = { 'legal_documents_validity_declaration': 'legal_documents_validity_declaration', 'policies_compliance_declaration': 'policies_compliance_declaration', 'non_disclosure_agreement': 'non_disclosure_agreement', } return mapping.get(declaration.x_declaration_type) or declaration.x_declaration_type
def looks_like_certificate(attachment): name = (attachment.name or '').lower() return ( 'certificate' in name or 'completion' in name or 'completed' in name or 'history' in name or 'audit' in name or 'trail' in name or 'شهادة' in name or 'إكمال' in name or 'اكمال' in name )
def looks_like_business_document(attachment): name = (attachment.name or '').lower() return ( 'f-0004' in name or 'f-0007' in name or 'f-0009' in name or 'إقرار' in name or 'اقرار' in name or 'declaration' in name or 'agreement' in name or 'validity' in name or 'policies' in name or 'non-disclosure' in name or 'nda' in name )
def find_registry(declaration): applicant = declaration.x_applicant_id doc_type = document_type_for(declaration)
registry = registry_model.search([ ('x_document_type', '=', doc_type), ('x_source_model', '=', 'x_hr.applicant_declaration'), ('x_source_res_id', '=', declaration.id), ], order='x_version desc, id desc', limit=1)
if registry: return registry
if applicant: registry = registry_model.search([ ('x_document_type', '=', doc_type), ('x_applicant_id', '=', applicant.id), ('x_signature_mode', '=', 'native_sign'), ('x_sign_request_res_id', '!=', False), ], order='x_version desc, id desc', limit=1)
return registry
for rec in records.sudo(): applicant = rec.x_applicant_id registry_doc = find_registry(rec)
certificate = False candidate_attachments = attachment_model.browse([])
if registry_doc and registry_doc.x_sign_certificate_attachment_id: certificate = registry_doc.x_sign_certificate_attachment_id
sign_request = False if registry_doc and registry_doc.x_sign_request_res_id: sign_request = sign_request_model.browse(registry_doc.x_sign_request_res_id) if sign_request.exists(): candidate_attachments |= sign_request.completed_document_attachment_ids candidate_attachments |= attachment_model.search([ ('res_model', '=', 'sign.request'), ('res_id', '=', sign_request.id), ('mimetype', '=', 'application/pdf'), ], order='create_date desc, id desc')
if applicant: candidate_attachments |= attachment_model.search([ ('res_model', '=', 'hr.applicant'), ('res_id', '=', applicant.id), ('mimetype', '=', 'application/pdf'), ], order='create_date desc, id desc')
candidate_attachments |= attachment_model.search([ ('res_model', '=', 'x_hr.applicant_declaration'), ('res_id', '=', rec.id), ('mimetype', '=', 'application/pdf'), ], order='create_date desc, id desc')
excluded_ids = [] if rec.x_pdf_attachment_id: excluded_ids.append(rec.x_pdf_attachment_id.id) if rec.x_signed_attachment_id: excluded_ids.append(rec.x_signed_attachment_id.id)
if registry_doc: if registry_doc.x_generated_attachment_id: excluded_ids.append(registry_doc.x_generated_attachment_id.id) if registry_doc.x_signed_attachment_id: excluded_ids.append(registry_doc.x_signed_attachment_id.id) if registry_doc.x_sign_completed_attachment_id: excluded_ids.append(registry_doc.x_sign_completed_attachment_id.id)
if not certificate: for attachment in candidate_attachments: if attachment.id in excluded_ids: continue if looks_like_certificate(attachment): certificate = attachment break
if not certificate: for attachment in candidate_attachments: if attachment.id in excluded_ids: continue if not looks_like_business_document(attachment): certificate = attachment break
if certificate and applicant and not (certificate.res_model == 'hr.applicant' and certificate.res_id == applicant.id): certificate = certificate.copy({ 'name': certificate.name or ('Certificate of completion - %s.pdf' % (rec.x_declaration_code or rec.x_name or 'Declaration')), 'res_model': 'hr.applicant', 'res_id': applicant.id, })
if certificate and registry_doc and (not registry_doc.x_sign_certificate_attachment_id or registry_doc.x_sign_certificate_attachment_id.id != certificate.id): registry_doc.write({ 'x_sign_certificate_attachment_id': certificate.id, 'x_notes': ((registry_doc.x_notes or '') + '\\nSignature certificate backfilled by generic declaration certificate helper on %s. Certificate attachment: %s.' % (datetime.datetime.now(), certificate.name)).strip(), })
if certificate: action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.act_url', 'url': '/web/content/%s?download=true' % certificate.id, 'target': 'self', } else: doc_type = document_type_for(rec) debug_hint = 'document_type=%s' % doc_type if registry_doc: debug_hint += ', registry_id=%s, sign_request_id=%s, candidates=%s' % ( registry_doc.id, registry_doc.x_sign_request_res_id or 'none', len(candidate_attachments), ) action = toast( 'لا توجد شهادة توقيع', 'لم يتم العثور على شهادة توقيع في سجل المستندات أو طلب التوقيع أو مرفقات المتقدم. %s' % debug_hint, 'warning', True, ) break
if not action: action = {'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'reload'}
